Deposit $100 into a Nonce Capital vault on Ethereum and keep the shares. Cost: $100 of capital and about $8 of gas. Time: 15 minutes to set up.
Make one qualifying action each week, such as a deposit, a swap, a vote or a claim. Cost: about $8 of gas a week. Time: 10 minutes a week.
Hold the position for at least 60 days so the activity is counted in more than one snapshot. Cost: the $100 stays in the position. Time: 60 days.
Before you withdraw, open the protocol's own points page and claim only from the link it publishes; a real airdrop never asks you to pay to claim. Cost: no fee to check. Time: 10 minutes.
Write the wallet, the dates and every transaction in a farm log so you can repeat the position or unwind it. Cost: nothing but the log. Time: 5 minutes.

Make one qualifying action each week, such as a deposit, a swap, a vote or a claim. Cost: about $8 of gas a week. Time: 10 minutes a week.

Write the wallet, the dates and every transaction in a farm log so you can repeat the position or unwind it. Cost: nothing but the log. Time: 5 minutes.

Before you withdraw, open the protocol's own rewards page and claim only from the link it publishes; never pay a fee to claim a reward. Cost: no fee to check. Time: 10 minutes.
Write the wallet, the dates and every transaction in a farm log so you can repeat the position or unwind it. Cost: nothing but the log. Time: 5 minutes.
